instruction: Open the Chrome extensions management page where all installed browser extensions are listed.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome extensions management page. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric to check if the active tab URL matches chrome://extensions/. Similar complexity to original task - single navigation action to Chrome internal page.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree address bar element
Metric correctly compares URLs by stripping query parameters, which is appropriate for Chrome internal URLs
Expected value chrome://extensions/ matches the actual Chrome extensions management page URL
Evaluator covers the single requirement: verify user navigated to chrome://extensions/ page
goto_prefix is correctly set to empty string to avoid adding unwanted prefixes to chrome:// URLs
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor risk: Chrome internal URLs (chrome://) may be displayed differently in accessibility tree. Consider adding postconfig to verify the page is accessible if getter returns None
Consider adding backup verification by checking page title or content to ensure the extensions page actually loaded (though current approach is sufficient for URL-based verification)
